scope: Import-scoped adapter retention and same-import comparison for a selected AC1018 STYLE_CONTROL to STYLE source pair.

implementation.selection: dx_iface::enableVerifiedStyleResourceSource(controlHandle, styleHandle) selects exactly one control/record pair and is mutually exclusive with the existing XRECORD candidate selection path.
implementation.reader_tickets: The existing DWG reader delivers only CRC-checked STYLE_CONTROL and STYLE tickets after complete frame coverage. dx_iface retains the selected source bodies and typed STYLE snapshot under the current import token and generation.
implementation.membership: The adapter parses the retained STYLE_CONTROL body and requires exactly one ordered STYLE member with role 2 matching the selected STYLE handle.
implementation.typed_binding: A bounded field comparison joins the source STYLE snapshot with exactly one same-import DRW_Textstyle callback row. Non-EED fields and ordered APPDATA/XDATA are compared; each deferred APPID slot must resolve to exactly one typed APPID row whose name matches the final group-1001 value. The source query also requires that APPID row to match its immutable import-generation snapshot across common table-entry fields, unknown71 and DWG name-source bytes. Pending layer references are refused. The shared retained-byte estimator bounds dynamic strings and data, with a 16 KiB total pair budget.
implementation.revalidation: dx_iface::hasUnchangedVerifiedStyleResourceSource rechecks import token/generation, selected source identities, control membership, live typed STYLE, and every referenced APPID against its immutable source snapshot. Missing, duplicated or mutated APPID rows refuse the source query.
implementation.output_policy: The source query does not authorize DWG/DXF replay, output ordering, graph closure or support claims.
